ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: necromancer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Necromancers treat death as a resource. Every fallen raider is a future soldier, a bomb, or a lesson.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Command death. Drain life, explode corpses and raise the fallen to fight for you.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'The dead do not complain,' said the necromancer. 'This is the main advantage.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Snowballing attrition. Your army grows with every kill: raise corpses, detonate the ones you can't use, and drain life to stay standing. Wants Focus and Potency.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: lich
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Liches trade their humanity for undying power. Their touch freezes the blood and their gaze kills.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Shed mortality. Freezing death magic, soul theft and the Finger of Death.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: Somewhere out there is a box with a heart in it. Find it, and maybe you can kill her.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A durable caster that refuses to die and kills anything big. Finger of Death deletes bosses; Lichform makes you nearly unkillable. Wants Focus and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: bonelord
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Bonelords raise legions. Bone spires guard their flanks, bone prisons trap their prey, and their dead never stop marching.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: An army of the dead and fortresses of bone.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The ossuary of Mallen-by-the-Rim holds four thousand bones. During the siege, it held none.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A full summoner. Keep corpses around, keep your army up, and empower them with Dark Command. Wants Focus and Attunement.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: plaguebringer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Plaguebringers cultivate disease like gardeners. A single carrier, a little patience, and an entire raid melts.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Rot, poison and plague. Infect one enemy and watch it spread.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'It started with one sick muffalo,' the survivor said. 'One.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Damage over time that spreads on its own. Seed the plague, keep enemies in Miasma, and let deaths burst into new infections. Wants Focus and Attunement.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: shambling horde
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Raise two more corpses per rank, and they last longer.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: soul harvest
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every soul that passes feeds you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: reaper
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Those you kill sometimes rise again to serve you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: death's embrace
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Closer to death, closer to power.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: master of graves
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your army is endless. Raise far more corpses for far longer, and those you kill often rise again.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: soul eater
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Consume souls directly. Massive lifesteal, a flood of mana on every kill, and kills shave seconds off your cooldowns.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: deathlord
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Death answers to you. Anything you kill may burst in a wave of necrotic energy.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: undeath
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your body is mostly magic now. Some of the harm you take drains mana instead.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: eternal vigil
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your phylactery holds. When you fall, you rise again in a wave of death. Once per day.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: dreadlord
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: An aura of dread weakens and chills every enemy near you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: archlich
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Death on demand. Finger of Death recharges much faster and necromancy hits harder.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: soulbound
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Spend twice as long in Lichform, more often, and drink the life of your foes.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: spire field
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Bone Spire raises an extra spire per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: endless ranks
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every raising spell raises another corpse per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: bonecaller
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your dead beget more dead: kills often rise to join you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: legion master
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every ally near you fights with the fury of Dark Command at all times.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: bone fortress
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Bone grows over you like armor, and when you are struck a spire may burst from the ground to defend you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: carrier
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You are patient zero. Enemies near you are steadily poisoned.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: immunity
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your own poisons no longer bother you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: black death
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everything you touch catches the plague, and everything you kill bursts.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: epidemiologist
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Precise and patient: plague magic lasts far longer, spreads further, and finishes off the weak.

AbilityDef.label: soul bolt
AbilityDef.description: A bolt of hungry, green soulfire.

AbilityDef.label: raise dead
AbilityDef.description: Raise up to two corpses near the target as undead thralls for a day. They fight for you, feel nothing, and need nothing.

AbilityDef.label: corpse explosion
AbilityDef.description: Detonate up to six corpses in an area. Bigger bodies make bigger bangs.

AbilityDef.label: drain life
AbilityDef.description: Rip the life out of a target and take it for yourself.

AbilityDef.label: bone armor
AbilityDef.description: Grow a cage of hardened bone around an ally.

AbilityDef.label: speak with the dead
AbilityDef.description: Interrogate a corpse. The dead share their most practiced skill with you, and the body rots quickly afterward.

li.flavor: Tell me, what did you know?

AbilityDef.label: enfeeble
AbilityDef.description: Curse an area. Enemies weaken, their wounds wither, and they suffer more from every blow.

AbilityDef.label: army of the dead
AbilityDef.description: Raise every corpse in a wide area - up to six - as thralls for a full day.

AbilityDef.label: corpse feast
AbilityDef.description: Draw the last life out of up to six corpses nearby. Each one heals you and refills your mana, then crumbles away.

AbilityDef.label: mark of the grave
AbilityDef.description: Brand an enemy for death. Their wounds fester, and if they die while marked they rise as your undead servant.

AbilityDef.label: death coil
AbilityDef.description: A spiralling coil of death that heals you for half the damage it deals.

AbilityDef.label: grave chill
AbilityDef.description: The cold of the tomb spills out from you, freezing enemies in place.

AbilityDef.label: soul rend
AbilityDef.description: Tear at the souls of everyone in an area, restoring your mana for each one you touch.

AbilityDef.label: lichform
AbilityDef.description: Become a lich for a minute: no pain, no hunger, halved damage, and terrible magical power.

AbilityDef.label: finger of death
AbilityDef.description: Point, and the target dies. Even the mightiest war machines are torn apart by a huge fraction of their own vitality.

AbilityDef.label: soul reap
AbilityDef.description: Tear a sliver of soul from every enemy around you. You are healed for part of the damage and your mana surges.

AbilityDef.label: bone spire
AbilityDef.description: Raise a spire of bone that fires splinters at enemies.

AbilityDef.label: bone prison
AbilityDef.description: Ribs of bone erupt in a ring around the target, trapping everyone inside.

AbilityDef.label: dark command
AbilityDef.description: Drive your undead and allies into a frenzy: faster, stronger, tireless.

AbilityDef.label: bone spear
AbilityDef.description: A line of bone spikes erupts from the ground toward the target.

AbilityDef.label: legion eternal
AbilityDef.description: Every corpse in a huge area rises - up to fifteen - for two full days, empowered by your will.

AbilityDef.label: bone storm
AbilityDef.description: A whirlwind of razor-edged bone spins around you for twelve seconds, shredding every enemy that comes close.

AbilityDef.label: plague bolt
AbilityDef.description: Infect a target with the black plague. Victims who die from it burst and infect those around them.

AbilityDef.label: miasma
AbilityDef.description: A choking cloud of rot settles over an area, poisoning everyone inside.

AbilityDef.label: contagion
AbilityDef.description: Every enemy near the target catches whatever it has: plague, poison and doom spread outward.

AbilityDef.label: swarm of rot
AbilityDef.description: Call forth a brood of megascarabs from the soil to swarm your enemies for a minute.

AbilityDef.label: pandemic
AbilityDef.description: Unleash a pandemic. Every enemy in an enormous area is infected, poisoned, cursed and withered, and the air itself turns toxic.

AbilityDef.label: plague rats
AbilityDef.description: A swarm of plague-ridden rats boils out of the ground. Their bites carry the black plague.

HediffDef.label: dark vigor
HediffDef.description: Driven onward by a necromancer's will.

ThingDef.label: bone spire focus
ThingDef.description: The focusing crystal of a conjured construct.

ThingDef.label: bone spire
ThingDef.description: A jagged spire of bone that hurls splinters at the living.

HediffDef.label: mark of the grave
HediffDef.description: Marked for death by a necromancer. Wounds fester, and if the bearer dies they will rise again as the necromancer's servant.
